# os.systemd

Manage a systemd unit file with daemon-reload, enable, start

| `install` | object | No | - |
| `name` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `path` | string | No | - |
| `reload_on_change` | boolean | No | - |

| `service` | object | No | - |
| `socket` | object | No | - |
| `started` | boolean | No | - |
